title: rorca-enrich-context-retrieval

userStories.title: Replace enrich route inline cascade with per-story retrieveContext() calls
userStories.description:
Refactor the POST /api/specs/:id/enrich route in backend/src/routes/specs.ts to replace its custom inline 4-layer retrieval cascade with calls to retrieveContext() from backend/src/lib/memory-router.ts — the same function used by the generate route. Instead of selecting memories ORDER BY created_at DESC and returning the same 10 memories for every story, call retrieveContext(workspaceId, story.title + ' ' + story.description, { maxTokens: 2000, includeGraph: true }) per story so each story receives semantically relevant memories via cosine similarity. Aggregate cagHits, ragHits, graphHits, and latencyMs across all per-story calls. After all stories are enriched, write a context_summary_json to spec_generation_logs using the canonical ContextSummary schema: { directionLayers: string[], skills: string[], memory: { count: number, tier: string, cagHits: number, ragHits: number, graphHits: number, latencyMs: number }, tokenBudget: { used: number, total: number }, flags: string[] }. The retrieval_method stored on the spec_generation_logs row must reflect the highest tier used across all stories (graph > vector > cag > direction_only).

## Context
The generate route at POST /api/specs/generate already uses memory-router.ts retrieveContext() correctly. The enrich route (around line 2800-2900 in specs.ts based on codebase size) duplicates this logic incorrectly: it queries memories with ORDER BY created_at DESC (recency, not relevance), always returns the same 10 memories for every story regardless of story content, hardcodes pgvector/tsvector/AGE logic directly in the route handler, and always emits cagHits: 0 because it never touches the CAG in-memory cache. The fix removes all inline retrieval logic and replaces it with the memory-router.ts call, mirroring how generate works.
acceptanceCriteria: The enrich route no longer contains inline pgvector/tsvector/AGE SQL queries for memory retrieval — all retrieval is delegated to retrieveContext() from memory-router.ts

Each story in the spec receives a separate retrieveContext(workspaceId, story.title + ' ' + story.description, { maxTokens: 2000, includeGraph: true }) call, producing story-specific memory matches via cosine similarity rather than the same recency-ordered list

Aggregate cagHits, ragHits, graphHits counts and total latencyMs are summed across all per-story retrieveContext calls and written to context_summary_json in spec_generation_logs after enrichment completes

The context_summary_json written to spec_generation_logs uses the canonical ContextSummary schema: { directionLayers, skills, memory: { count, tier, cagHits, ragHits, graphHits, latencyMs }, tokenBudget, flags } — the same schema written by the generate route

The retrieval_method column on the spec_generation_logs row is set to the highest tier actually used across all stories: 'graph' if any story triggered AGE traversal, 'vector' if any used RAG, 'cag' if only CAG cache was hit, 'direction_only' if memory was empty

suggestedSkills.name: database-optimization
suggestedSkills.reason: The fix removes inline SQL queries (pgvector cosine similarity, tsvector BM25, AGE graph traversal) from the route handler and routes through memory-router.ts — understanding how these queries work is needed to verify the delegation is correct

suggestedSkills.name: spec-gap-analysis
suggestedSkills.reason: The story requires comparing the existing enrich route's retrieval behavior against the generate route's memory-router.ts path to identify exactly what inline logic to remove and what to replace it with

userStories.title: Update SpecDetailSlideOver Context tab to render ContextSummaryCard for enriched specs
userStories.description:
Update the Context tab in SpecDetailSlideOver (src/components/SpecDetailSlideOver.tsx) so that specs enriched via rorca_enrich_spec display the same rich ContextSummaryCard as generated specs — showing CAG hits, Vector RAG hits, Graph hits, Skills, Token bar, and retrieval_method badge. Currently the Context tab may render a degraded or empty view for enriched specs because the context_summary_json from the enrich route uses a different schema than the generate route (missing cagHits, always 0 ragHits, missing tier). After US-001 fixes the backend to write canonical ContextSummary JSON, this story ensures the frontend ContextSummaryCard component reads and displays all fields correctly for enriched specs. The retrieval_method badge must reflect the highest tier used (graph/vector/cag/direction_only) from the aggregated context_summary_json. If the spec has no spec_generation_logs entry (e.g. manually created specs), the Context tab shows a 'No context data available' empty state rather than crashing.

## Context
SpecDetailSlideOver has a 'Context' tab added by the rorca-live-spec-terminal spec (LST-004). The ContextSummaryCard component renders directionLayers, skills, memory stats (count, tier, cagHits, ragHits, graphHits, latencyMs), and a tokenBudget bar. After US-001 the enrich route writes the same schema as generate, so this story only needs to verify the frontend correctly maps the new fields and that the retrieval_method badge appears for enriched specs. Check that ContextSummaryCard does not assume specs were generated (e.g. no hardcoded 'Generated' label) — it should work for both generated and enriched specs.
acceptanceCriteria: The Context tab in SpecDetailSlideOver renders the full ContextSummaryCard for specs enriched via rorca_enrich_spec, showing: direction layer count, skills list, memory.count, memory.tier, memory.cagHits, memory.ragHits, memory.graphHits, memory.latencyMs, tokenBudget bar

The retrieval_method badge in the Context tab correctly displays the highest tier used (graph/vector/cag/direction_only) from the aggregated context_summary_json written by the enrich route after US-001
The ContextSummaryCard does not hardcode 'Generated' or assume a specific origin — it renders identically whether the spec_generation_logs entry was created by the generate or enrich route

If a spec has no spec_generation_logs entry, the Context tab shows a non-crashing empty state: 'No context data available' message with a subtle description explaining context is populated after generation or enrichment

=== GLOBAL STANDARDS (L1) ===
test: true

=== PROJECT CONTEXT (L3) ===
name: rorca
type: web-app
purpose: >-
  AI spec orchestration and pipeline management platform. Converts plain-English briefs
  into structured specs (user stories with acceptance criteria), then executes each story
  as an isolated agent subprocess with full tool access — bash, edit, read, write, glob, grep.
  Tracks progress in real time via SSE/WAL events. Supports three execution engines:
  claude --print (Claude subscription), opencode run (75+ providers), codex (ChatGPT subscription).

stack:
  - React 18
  - TypeScript (strict)
  - Vite 5
  - Tailwind CSS 3
  - xterm.js (@xterm/xterm)
  - react-router-dom v7
  - Express.js
  - PostgreSQL 16 (pg Pool, pgvector, Apache AGE)
  - Node.js >= 20
  - Vitest (frontend tests)
  - Jest (backend tests)
  - Playwright (E2E)
  - Docker Compose

key_modules:
  - src/panels/ — 5 primary panels (SpecsPanel, RunsPanel, AnalyticsPanel, DirectionPanel, SettingsPanel)
  - src/components/ — Shared UI (Shell, Sidebar, RunTerminal, SpecDetailSlideOver, CommandPalette)
  - src/contexts/ — WorkspaceContext, AuthContext, ThemeContext, ToastContext
  - backend/src/routes/ — 32 Express route files (specs, pipeline, workspaces, direction, skills, etc.)
  - backend/src/lib/ — Core services (execution-engine, sse-hub, direction-stack, llm-client, context-router, workspace-echolocation)
  - backend/src/db/ — PostgreSQL Pool, pg-index.ts migration runner, pg-migrations/ (001–049)
  - backend/src/mcp/ — MCP stdio server (5 tools, HTTP transport target)
  - forge/ — run-loop.sh (bash fallback), self-register.ts, spec JSON files
  - packs/ — Convention pack directory (planned)

ports:
  frontend: 5210
  backend: 3030
  finops_sim: 5200

constraints:
  - Backend requires manual restart (no hot-reload via tsx)
  - Auth middleware globally bypassed — local single-user tool
  - WAL wal_events.ts column is ts not created_at
  - spec.id is filename slug — never use specName for paths
  - pg uses numbered placeholders $1/$2 not ?
  - chatComplete returns ChatResult.text — not a plain string

deployment_target: self-hosted (npm run dev locally), Docker Compose, future binary via bun build --compile

integrations:
  - GitHub OAuth + webhooks (partially built)
  - Linear (planned)
  - Vercel (planned)
  - Slack (planned)
  - Claude Code MCP (stdio + HTTP transport)
  - skills.sh registry

=== PROJECT MEMORY (Git History) ===
```yaml
architectural_decisions:
  - description: "Direction stack now 6-layer: L0 (convention packs) → L1 (global eng principles) → L2 (domain) → L3 (project) → L4 (spec brief) → L5 (story annotations). Lower layers override higher (CSS specificity model)."
    evidence: "Convention pack system commit — L0 layer introduced for community-driven conventions below user-defined L1-L5"
  
  - description: "Single execution engine (execution-engine.ts) replaces all bash/TypeScript variants. Supports 3 agent types (claude, opencode, codex) with shared tool set (edit, bash, read, write, glob, grep, webfetch, websearch)."
    evidence: "run-loop.ts (1780 lines) deleted — execution-engine.ts is single source of truth"
  
  - description: "PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector + Apache AGE replaces SQLite. Enables vector search, graph queries, concurrent writes. Port 5433 to avoid user's local Postgres on 5432."
    evidence: "rorca-postgres-migration.json spec created, better-sqlite3 → pg for distribution compatibility (bun build --compile breaks on native addons)"
  
  - description: "Skills are L0 context (below L1-L5 direction stack). LLM matches skills per story during spec generation. No embeddings — single LLM call with skill catalog + MEMORY.md + AGENTS.md + story text outputs relevance scores (1-10) + reasoning."
    evidence: "LLM-driven skill matching commits — piggybacks on spec generation, zero extra API cost. Signal hierarchy: MEMORY.md (strongest) → AGENTS.md → story text → domain L2"
  
  - description: "Skills dual-injected: Claude via .claude/skills/ auto-discovery (native), OpenCode/Codex via buildPrompt() manual injection. Token budgeting through enforceBudget() sorted by LLM relevance score."
    evidence: "react.md + tailwind.md added to both .claude/skills/ and .rorca/skills/ for dual injection"
  
  - description: "Convention packs = frameworks for AI development. Directory structure: packs/<name>/ with direction/, personas/, conventions/, templates/, scaffold/, AGENTS.md. Installed packs populate .rorca/ + direction stack + project scaffold."
    evidence: "Convention pack system + pack_registry table (migration 040) + API routes for install/fork/uninstall"
  
  - description: "Greenfield vs Brownfield onboarding: Greenfield = top-down convention injection from packs. Brownfield = bottom-up convention extraction (agent scans codebase → generates L3 + CLAUDE.md + AGENTS.md → human approval via convention_proposals table)."
    evidence: "Convention inference agent + convention_proposals table (migration 040) for brownfield workflow"
  
  - description: "Agent persona system: Stories support 'persona' + 'reviewers' fields. Personas stored in .rorca/personas/ with 4 categories (_primary/, _adversarial/, _specialist/, _review/). buildPrompt() injects persona markdown before story execution."
    evidence: "15 default personas added (architect, pm, lead-dev, red-team, assumption-buster, devils-advocate, spec-writer, spec-verifier, best-practices, etc.)"
  
  - description: "Multi-pass spec generation pipeline: PM → Spec Writer → UX Designer → Best Practices → Adversarial → Verifier. Each pass refines previous output. Goal: exhaustive specs (every state/edge case/button label explicit, 20-50K words so 'a blind person can implement')."
    evidence: "Multi-pass spec generation commits + spec_versions table for version history per pass"

    evidence: "rorca-distribution.json spec created, bin/rorca.ts CLI added with 'rorca start' and 'rorca init'"

Rejected: separate skills routing (duplicates work), bulk install 30+ skills (context pollution), embedding similarity search (replaced by LLM reasoning)."

conventions:
  - rule: "Direction stack precedence: lower layer number overrides higher (L0 < L1 < L2 < L3 < L4 < L5). L0 = convention packs (community defaults), L1-L3 = user-defined, L4-L5 = spec-specific."
  
  - rule: "Persona categories use underscore prefix directories: _primary/, _adversarial/, _specialist/, _review/. Persona files are markdown with YAML frontmatter."
  
  - rule: "Skills dual-saved: .rorca/skills/ (Rorca internal) + .claude/skills/ (Claude CLI auto-discovery). Both copies kept in sync during install/uninstall."
  
  - rule: "Convention packs must have: pack.json (metadata), direction/, personas/, conventions/, templates/, scaffold/, AGENTS.md. Pack loader validates structure before install."
  
  - rule: "LLM skill matching output format: suggestedSkills array per story with { name, relevanceScore (1-10), reason (cites MEMORY.md/AGENTS.md/L2) }."
  
  - rule: "Skill content injection: Claude = noop (auto-discovered), OpenCode/Codex = buildPrompt() reads .rorca/skills/<name>.md + injects into prompt before story execution."
  
  - rule: "Convention proposals (brownfield extraction) stored in convention_proposals table with status: pending/approved/rejected. Human reviews before applying to direction_layers or writing CLAUDE.md."
  
  - rule: "Postgres port 5433 (not 5432) to avoid conflict with user's local Postgres. ~/.rorca/postgres/ for bundled Postgres data directory."
  
  - rule: "Per-story model override precedence: story.model > run --model flag > workspace L3 preferred_model > DEFAULT_MODEL. Escalation (Haiku→Sonnet→Opus) still applies after selection."
  
  - rule: "CLI commands: 'rorca start' (Express + built frontend on :3030), 'rorca init' (bootstrap workspace with .rorca/ directory). bin/rorca.ts is entry point."

avoid:
  - approach: "Separate routing system for skills (dedicated config.json block, heuristic matching, embedding vectors)."
    reason: "Skills are files — context-router.ts already handles micromatch path scoping + priority + token budgeting. LLM matching piggybacks on spec generation (zero extra cost). Embeddings add latency + infrastructure for negligible accuracy gain over LLM reasoning with MEMORY.md context."
  
  - approach: "Bulk install 30+ skills from skills.sh registry on workspace setup."
    reason: "Context pollution. Token waste. Most skills irrelevant to most stories. LLM-driven per-story matching is selective — only injects relevant skills based on story text + MEMORY.md + AGENTS.md."
  
  - approach: "better-sqlite3 for distribution."
    reason: "Native C++ addon breaks bun build --compile. Switched to PostgreSQL (pure JS pg driver) enables standalone binary compilation AND unlocks vectors/graph (pgvector, Apache AGE)."
  
  - approach: "npm publish for distribution (source code visible in node_modules)."
    reason: "Business model requires source protection. Standalone binary via bun build --compile hides source, no runtime dependency. Install script (curl | sh) downloads binary to /usr/local/bin."
  
  - approach: "Auto-commit runtime state files (.rorca/run-state.json, progress.txt)."
    reason: "Causes merge conflicts during wave-based parallel execution (multiple worktrees writing same files). Added .gitignore patterns — runtime state is ephemeral, not source of truth."
  
  - approach: "Multiple execution engine implementations (run-loop.sh bash variant, run-loop.ts TypeScript variant, execution-engine.ts)."
    reason: "Code duplication. Diverging behavior across agents. Consolidated to execution-engine.ts only — single source of truth for claude, opencode, codex. run-loop.sh kept as bash fallback (only used if execution-engine.ts missing)."
  
  - approach: "Auto-promote skills based on effectiveness analytics (auto-install high-performing skills)."
    reason: "Removes user agency. Show effectiveness data in UI (SkillAnalyticsWidget), let user decide. Explicit > implicit for skill adoption."
```

=== SPEC BRIEF (L4) ===
Fix rorca_enrich_spec to use the same retrieval pipeline as rorca_generate_spec.

The enrich route (POST /api/specs/:id/enrich in backend/src/routes/specs.ts) currently implements its own inline 4-layer retrieval cascade that:
- Selects memories ORDER BY created_at DESC (recency, not relevance)
- Returns the same 10 memories for every story (no per-story cosine similarity)
- Always reports cagHits: 0 (never uses memory-router.ts CAG cache)
- Has its own hardcoded pgvector/AGE/tsvector/direction-only logic disconnected from memory-router.ts

The generate route (POST /api/specs/generate) correctly calls retrieveContext(workspaceId, queryText, { maxTokens, includeGraph }) from backend/src/lib/memory-router.ts which does:
- Step 1: CAG — in-memory cache of direction layers + recent memories (0ms)
- Step 2: RAG — hybridSearch() triggered when cache coverage drops below threshold (pgvector cosine similarity + tsvector BM25 RRF hybrid, ~100ms)
- Step 3: Graph — Apache AGE traversal when includeGraph: true

The fix: replace the enrich route's inline cascade with a call to retrieveContext() per story. Each story gets its own retrieveContext(workspaceId, story.title + ' ' + story.description) call so different stories get semantically different memories matched via cosine similarity. The retrieved context per story replaces the current shared retrievedContext block.

context_summary_json written to spec_generation_logs must use the ContextSummary schema (directionLayers, skills, memory: { count, tier, cagHits, ragHits, graphHits, latencyMs }, tokenBudget, flags) so the UI ContextSummaryCard renders the rich card identically to generated specs. Aggregate cagHits/ragHits/graphHits across all per-story retrieveContext calls.

Story annotations: each story's ## Context block now contains memories specifically relevant to THAT story (different per story) rather than the same 10 most recent memories for all stories.

UI: the Context tab for enriched specs must now show the same rich ContextSummaryCard (CAG hits, Vector RAG hits, Graph hits, Skills, Token bar) as generated specs. The retrieval_method badge should reflect the highest tier used across all stories.
